_comment: Single source of truth for vehicle presets and editable parameters. Read by otis/vehicles.py and by web/plant.js + app.js. Units are SI.

point_mass.label: Max thrust per axis
point_mass.help: Thrust at full throttle along x and along y. Throttle is limited to [-1, 1] per axis.

point_mass.label: Linear drag
point_mass.help: Drag force = coefficient × velocity, opposing motion. 0 = vacuum.

point_mass.label: Gravity
point_mass.help: Acts in −y. Hidden in the UI: each preset keeps its own value (UAV 9.81, others 0).

point_mass.label: Mission time
point_mass.help: Every plan is 50 thrust commands spread evenly over this time.

point_mass.label: Workspace half-width
point_mass.help: Starts and goals lie in a square of ± this size. Training samples missions from it.

point_mass.label: Start-speed range
point_mass.help: Initial velocity per axis is drawn from ± this value for training and Random.

point_mass.label: Fuel weight λ
point_mass.help: Objective J = miss² + λ·Σu². Larger λ saves fuel at the cost of accuracy, and makes the problem better conditioned (lower stiffness κ), so the network trains faster.

bicycle.label: Max acceleration
bicycle.help: Longitudinal acceleration at full throttle (also full braking).

bicycle.label: Speed limit
bicycle.help: Cruise-speed cap used by the pursuit planner.

bicycle.label: Mission time
bicycle.help: Every plan is 50 commands spread evenly over this time.

bicycle.label: Workspace half-width
bicycle.help: Starts and goals lie in a square of ± this size.

bicycle.label: Start-speed range
bicycle.help: Initial speed range used by Random.

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.blurb: A free-flying thruster craft. The preset is the unit plant the published network was trained on (1 kg, 1 N, vacuum, 4 s).

uav.name: UAV
uav.blurb: A multirotor flying in a vertical plane: Earth gravity, light drag, thrust-to-weight about 2.

usv.name: USV
usv.blurb: A small surface vessel seen from above: no gravity in the plane, strong hydrodynamic drag (top speed = thrust ÷ drag).
